daily_gate_conversion.scope: unique policy-eligible CopyIntents; each intent has exactly one terminal stage
daily_gate_conversion.scope_exclusion: upstream source signals rejected before policy eligibility are not present in this funnel

defense_regret.rule: two consecutive actual-red/counterfactual-green days auto-pull framework audit and defense recalibration review
defense_regret.symmetry_guard: measurement only; no live cap or threshold mutation without the framework audit and Fable authority

highest_rejection_gate_ev.caveat: Paper outcome is valued at the observed source entry and does not prove executable fill price, liquidity, latency, or independence across intents.

multi_day_roi_distribution.basis: canonical end-of-day scorecards; partial current day included and labeled by day
multi_day_roi_distribution.projection_caveat: Linear scaling assumes unchanged fill rate, liquidity, slippage, fees, and edge; it is not live authority.

participation_288_map.definition: participation per slot; profitability graded on daily/hour-band aggregates

reject_cluster.counting_basis: ledger orders; one row per recorded taker reject or maker fallback reject
